mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wallet_account WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_account SET available_balance = available_balance + #{availableDelta}, held_balance = held_balance + #{heldDelta}, escrowed_balance = escrowed_balance + #{escrowedDelta}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND available_balance + #{availableDelta} >= 0 AND held_balance + #{heldDelta} >= 0 AND escrowed_balance + #{escrowedDelta} >= 0
